description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android project. It specifies a method for outputting log data, supporting chaining of log nodes, and comments describe potential implementations and uses.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging component that outputs log data, optionally to multiple targets and supports chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output log data with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
